---
name: to-tickets
description: Decompose a specification into small, testable vertical tickets for this songbook repository.
---

Read `docs/spec.md`, `docs/tickets.md`, and `docs/agents/domain.md`. Break the requested scope into small vertical slices that can be implemented and verified independently. Every ticket must include an ID, user story, priority and phase labels, technical scope, dependencies, and executable acceptance criteria. Keep API, data, client, and UI work together when they form one user-facing slice. Update `docs/tickets.md` only when the user asks to write the backlog.
